issues: Divisible oxygen reserve cannot plausibly serve 1 vs 1,000 or 1,000 vs 1,000,000 patients (large patched as a whole country); no natural rescale; same redirect skeleton as b021/b022.
One ventilator cannot treat 1,000 patients, nor 1,000 ventilators 1,000,000; 'lowest survival odds' confounds the tradeoff; plural/singular templating errors.
No nation has 1,000,000 dialysis patients and one patient's treated water cannot cover 1,000; no natural rescale in a kidney network.
Medium 'care campus with one patient' and AI-sealed city district are implausible; same contain-the-infected structure as b030, which scales naturally.
Templated Group/projection skeleton and 'release the vaccine lot now' wording rewritten; lot size and setting rescaled per scale (island lot, city lot, national run); defer cost made explicit.
A shipment sized for one destination cannot save 1 or 1,000,000 patients at will; 1,000,000 dying patients at one destination is impossible; near-duplicate redirect of b016/b022.
Last stock of O-negative blood cannot serve 1,000 vs 1,000,000 patients; divisible resource with no natural rescale; same withdraw skeleton as b016/b023.
Doses for 1,000 mid-course patients cannot start courses for 1,000,000 from a 'nearly gone' stockpile; no natural rescale; near-duplicate of b022.
No single drug lot could kill 1,000,000, and patients do not depend on one interchangeable lot; 'one patient depend' templating error.
Orbital habitats with 1,000 or 1,000,000 residents are not a plausible present-day setting; no Earth rescale without duplicating b_1 doors; 'one person are' error.
Orbital habitat with 1,000,000 aboard is implausible; no natural rescale; same seal-off-the-few skeleton as b025/b029.
1,000 people on EVA and 1,000,000 aboard a habitat are implausible; no natural rescale.
A coastal rescue fleet cannot rescue 1,000,000 flood victims; redirecting away a rescue is closer to allowing than causing death.
1,000 trapped on one mine level and a mine fire killing 1,000,000 in a city above are impossible; no natural rescale; 'one person are' error.

Small scale had a lethal outbreak killing only five in a port city; rescaled to island station/island town/metro region; 'one passenger aboard are' and templated skeleton rewritten; act/refuse labels made explicit since act means denying entry.
